name: 006-duplicate-while-buffered
description: An operation delivered TWICE while its origin is still missing, then the origin. Distinct from 004: there the duplicate lands in a document that already holds the operation, so a structure-based check catches it. Here both copies go into the PENDING buffer, and a replica that only checks the structure integrates both when the origin arrives - duplicating the text AND putting one identifier in two blocks, which makes a later delete tombstone only one of the copies.
